subject: Crash FM listener
author: ZombieTron
body:
I listened to the podcast, as I do every week now! And I am really looking forward to Paradise! I was a little concerned when it was mentioned that there are still a couple of months of development to go. I am doubtful we will see the game this year now! oh well, as Xandu told me I wont get to play it over Christmas if it is out then anyway as I will be in Norway, so I guess an early January release would be fine??? who knows when it will be out, but when we do eventually get to play it Im sure it will knock our heads off!!
